recommended_approach: Project-scoped adaptation of debugging, verification, planning and review; single-context execution by default; no global bootstrap or autonomous subagents

phase_1.purpose: Adopt useful process without changing model/data/runtime behavior

phase_2.purpose: Evaluate on bounded, explicitly requested project tasks

phase_3.purpose: Optional plugin or subagent rollout after checking actual version and scope
phase_3.model_overrides: Follow actual session permissions and available model list; do not copy external presets automatically

domain_gates: Do not modify D:/Live score Project
No credential in source, client bundles or exported diagnostics
No provider call from tests without explicit scoped authorization
Mock transport and isolated local D1 for infrastructure tests
Unknown identity/date conflicts stay unverified or quarantined
No feature/result known after the prediction cutoff
No prediction at or after kickoff
Do not tune thresholds or choose leagues on final holdout
Do not rewrite frozen model/evaluation evidence
No production deployment or paid service activation
Do not park data leakage or failed statistical acceptance as workflow completion
Retain required evidence before deleting temporary workflow artifacts
